Cleveland Police Receive Additional Funding for Serious Crime Tackling

Cleveland Police have been allocated an additional £2 million to enhance their efforts in tackling serious crime. This funding is intended to support the force's operations, particularly in the Middlesbrough area. The allocation follows a recent deadly crash, though the direct link between the crash and the funding's purpose is not explicitly detailed in the coverage. The funds are designated for addressing serious criminal activity within the region.
